title: Should LLMs, like, Generate How Users Talk? Building Dialect-Accurate Dialog[ue]s Beyond the American Default with MDial

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance disparities across 9 English dialects using a parallel multi-turn benchmark (MDialBench) for dialect identification and response completion tasks, and analyzing confusion matrices to measure default prediction biases toward high-resource Standard American (US) and British (GB) English.

Using human preference annotations and LLM-as-a-judge evaluations across lexical, orthographic, and morphosyntactic dimensions to assess whether generated dialect responses are authentic or rely on exaggerated, outdated, and stereotypical representations.
